purpose: Write a Domain lens briefing for a deterministic CodeGraph snapshot: pitch, domains, processes, onboarding, and risk.
evidenceRule: Domains cite supplied clusterId values. Processes cite supplied flowId values. Onboarding steps cite supplied cluster, node, or flow ids matching refType. Risk items cite supplied hotspot or cycle ids matching refType. Summaries cite supplied clusterId values for UI compatibility. Invented ids are forbidden.
instructions: Return one complete Domain lens JSON package. Write a 2-3 sentence project pitch. Name and explain the top supplied domains in plain English. Tell short process stories for the supplied flows. Provide up to five ordered onboarding steps. Brief the supplied hotspots and cycles as risk. Mirror domains into summaries for backward UI compatibility. Use exact ids from evidence only. Omit unsupported claims. Return COMPLETE COMPACT JSON with keys pitch, domains, processes, onboarding, risk, and summaries.
